Vendor / adp workforce now cost

ADP Workforce Now pricing in 2026

ADP Workforce Now is quote-only across all four tiers (Essential, Enhanced, Premium, HR Pro). Buying-committee evidence puts Essential at ~$10 PEPM and HR Pro at ~$28 PEPM. Per-payroll-run fees stack on top. Implementation runs $1,500-$15,000 for 100-250 employee migrations. SSO and webhook API access are commonly upsold.

What the buying committee actually pays

Tax filing is bundled. SSO and webhook API are commonly upsold. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What do the four tiers cost?

Buying-committee bands: Essential ~$10 PEPM, Enhanced ~$15 PEPM, Premium ~$22 PEPM, HR Pro ~$28 PEPM. All quote-only.

How much is the per-payroll-run fee?

$3-$6 per employee per run, depending on tier. Bi-weekly payroll therefore adds $78-$156 per employee per year on top of the subscription line.

What is implementation for 100-250 employees?

$1,500-$5,000 for 100 employees. $5,000-$15,000 for 250 employees on the full HR Pro suite with multi-state tax filing.

Does ADP charge for SSO and API?

SSO and webhook API access are typically separate SKUs in the published quote. SSO is rarely waived even on multi-year commits.

How does ADP compare to Paychex Flex post-Paycor?

ADP retains the larger enterprise footprint and stronger tax-filing depth. Paychex Flex (now owning Paycor) wins on price for sub-100 employee deployments.
